Features

🎬 Transparent Video

Support for videos with alpha channel transparency using HEVC codec.

✨ Smooth Transitions

Configurable fade in and fade out durations for smooth visibility changes.

🔄 Toggle Control

Show, hide, and toggle methods for easy visibility control.

📱 Browser Detection

Automatic HEVC alpha codec support detection for fallback handling.

Usage

Basic Usage

import { TransparentVideoOverlay } from 'move.gl'; const overlay = new TransparentVideoOverlay({ videoUrl: 'path/to/video-alpha.mp4', containerId: 'overlay-container', videoId: 'overlay-video', fadeInDuration: 500, fadeOutDuration: 500, loop: true }); // Show the overlay with fade in overlay.show(); // Hide the overlay with fade out overlay.hide(); // Toggle visibility overlay.toggle(); // Change video source overlay.setSource('path/to/new-video.mp4'); // Clean up overlay.destroy();

HEVC Alpha Detection

import { supportsHEVCAlpha } from 'move.gl'; // Check if browser supports HEVC alpha if (supportsHEVCAlpha()) { // Use transparent video overlay.setSource('video-alpha.mp4'); } else { // Fallback to non-alpha video or image overlay.setSource('video-fallback.mp4'); }

HTML Structure

<!-- Video overlay container --> <div id="overlay-container" class="video-overlay"> <video id="overlay-video" muted playsinline> <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4"> </video> </div>

API Reference

VideoOverlayOptions Interface

interface VideoOverlayOptions { videoUrl: string; // URL for video source containerId?: string; // Container element ID videoId?: string; // Video element ID fadeInDuration?: number; // Fade in time (ms) fadeOutDuration?: number; // Fade out time (ms) loop?: boolean; // Loop video playback }

Methods

Method Description
show() Show the overlay with fade in effect
hide() Hide the overlay with fade out effect
toggle() Toggle overlay visibility
setSource(url: string) Change the video source
destroy() Clean up and release resources

Utility Functions

Function Description
supportsHEVCAlpha() Check if browser supports HEVC alpha codec
